title: gesneria plumieriana
intro: Gesneria plumieriana, commonly known as the Red Columnea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gesneria plumieriana include acting as an antimicrobial agent, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Gesneria plumieriana include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
